abstract: The autopsy of a 28-year-old Japanese male patient, which revealed immature teratoma combined with choriocarcinoma in the mediastinum, is presented. The tumor, which was removed after chemotherapy, was localized in the superior-anterior mediastinum. Chemotherapy was performed several times after operation. However, HCG increased again, and a roentgenogram revealed metastatic shadows in both lungs. The metastatic tumors in the lungs showed only the choriocarcinoma.
abstract_ja: 剖検により、縦隔に未熟奇形腫と絨毛癌が併存していた28歳日本人男性の症例を報告する。腫瘍は化学療法後に切除されたが、切除部位は前上縦隔に限局していた。術後も化学療法を複数回実施した。しかし、hCGが再び上昇し、胸部X線写真で両肺に転移影が認められた。肺の転移巣は絨毛癌のみからなっていた。
